remarks: Welcome Home Near Cove Island Park!  Live just steps from one of Stamford's best attractions Cove Island Park as well as Chelsea Piers and New York Sports Club. This 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience.  Enjoy a beautifully updated kitchen and modern baths, in-unit washer & dryer, hardwood floors, and a spacious primary suite with vaulted ceilings and a walk-in closet. Additional highlights include an attic and private storage room, plus a deck, front porch, and stairs.  Located in a private 3-unit complex with low common charges, this home also features a peaceful backyard, and is perfectly situated for commuters just minutes from I-95, Metro-North, and the Darien border.  This is a rare find that offers the privacy of a house with the ease of condo living!
